value.rationale: The smallest nonregular graph has a sharp weak-coupling phase where every global minimax two-update sampler must use a nonedge, contradicting the natural edge-only rule derived in a regular-graph model. It supplies a complete exact optimal value and implementable sampling policy over all nine ordered pairs rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. No higher-dimensional, long-run or runtime advantage is asserted.
